tasks.subject: Task 1: Add GreenStageModeInterpreter and GreenAiBattleLevels helpers (TDD)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add two pure-function helpers under `Application/Common/` with full unit-test coverage, so the handler edit in Task 2 has tested primitives to call.

**Files:**
- Create: `Application/Common/GreenStageModeInterpreter.cs`
- Create: `Application/Common/GreenAiBattleLevels.cs`
- Create: `Tests/Green/GreenStageModeInterpreterTests.cs`
- Create: `Tests/Green/GreenAiBattleLevelsTests.cs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `GreenStageModeInterpreter.IsShin(stageMode)` returns true iff `stageMode is 1 or 4`
- [ ] `GreenStageModeInterpreter.IsAiBattle(stageMode)` returns true iff `stageMode is 3 or 4`
- [ ] `GreenAiBattleLevels.IsCertifiedLevel(sdCertifiedLevelId)` returns true iff `sdCertifiedLevelId is 1 or 5 or 9 or 13`
- [ ] All four files compile in their respective projects
- [ ] Helper tests pass

**Verify:** `dotnet test Tests/Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~GreenStageModeInterpreter|FullyQualifiedName~GreenAiBattleLevels"` exits 0.

**Steps:** See `01-helpers.md` — write failing tests, add helpers, rerun, commit.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Wire helpers into UpdatePlayResultCommand.Green
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Edit `Application/Handlers/UpdatePlayResultCommand.Green.cs` so it accepts AI Battle plays, routes Shin via the interpreter, gates crown updates by AI difficulty, and sets `GhostPlayedSongFlag` bits.

**Files:**
- Modify: `Application/Handlers/UpdatePlayResultCommand.Green.cs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `MaxGreenStageMode` constant removed; `IsValidGreenStage` now requires `stage.StageMode is 0 or 1 or 3 or 4`
- [ ] `isShin` is computed via `GreenStageModeInterpreter.IsShin(stage.StageMode)`
- [ ] `UpsertBestAsync` accepts a new `bool allowCrownUpdate` parameter; it only writes `BestCrown` when that is true
- [ ] Crown gate at call site: `allowCrownUpdate = !IsAiBattle(stage.StageMode) || stage.Level == 5 || IsCertifiedLevel(stage.GhostStageData?.SdCertifiedLevelId ?? 0)`
- [ ] New private static `ApplyGhostPlayedSongBits(saveData, playResultData)` sets bit `stage.SongNo` in `saveData.GhostPlayedSongFlag` for each AI Battle stage
- [ ] All pre-existing Green tests still pass (no regression)

**Verify:** `dotnet test Tests/Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~Green"` exits 0.

**Steps:** See `02-handler-edits.md` for the line-by-line patch.

```json:metadata
{"files":["Application/Handlers/UpdatePlayResultCommand.Green.cs"],"verifyCommand":"dotnet test Tests/Tests.csproj --filter \"FullyQualifiedName~Green\"","acceptanceCriteria":["StageMode validation allows {0,1,3,4}","IsShin computed via interpreter","Crown gated by AI difficulty rule","GhostPlayedSongFlag bits set","No regressions in existing Green tests"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: AI Battle play-result integration tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add end-to-end handler tests that exercise the full AI Battle flow through the in-memory fixture: persisted play row, section rows, ghost updates, crown gating, PlayedSong bit, and rejection of unknown stage modes.

**Files:**
- Create: `Tests/Green/GreenAiBattlePlayResultTests.cs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Test `AcceptsAiBattlePlay` — result==1; play row, section rows, winnings, token, perf, rank, total-winnings, PlayedSong bit, ReleaseInfo bit all persisted
- [ ] Test `AiBattleShinRoutesToShinBest` — StageMode=4 upserts into (IsShin=true) best row
- [ ] Test `AiBattleIntermediateAiDifficultyDoesNotUpdateCrown` — SdCertifiedLevelId=11, pre-seeded BestCrown=None, post-state still None, score updated
- [ ] Test `AiBattleCertifiedAiDifficultyUpdatesCrown` — SdCertifiedLevelId=13, post-state BestCrown=Gold
- [ ] Test `AiBattleUraAlwaysUpdatesCrown` — Level=5, arbitrary non-正規 SdCertifiedLevelId, crown updates
- [ ] Test `RejectsAiBattleStageModeTwoAndFive` — StageMode=2 and 5 both rejected; nothing persisted
- [ ] Test `NonAiBattlePlayDoesNotTouchGhostFields` — normal PlayMode=0 with null GhostUpdate fields leaves ghost columns/tokens/winnings untouched and GhostPlayedSongFlag clear

**Verify:** `dotnet test Tests/Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~GreenAiBattlePlayResult"` exits 0.

**Steps:** See `03-integration-tests.md` for the full test file contents.
